addition.item: ⁠Audit: new llms.txt line. The Fix button creates the file, then Astus keeps it up to date like the sitemap.
⁠Audit: new “AI robots” line, read from robots.txt. It turns orange if an AI search robot is blocked; Astus changes nothing.
⁠Multilingual site: each page declares its language to Google (hreflang), with no setting.
⁠Visitor assistant: a link in your pages can open it (data-astus-ouvrir attribute).

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. Nothing to set again.

addition.item: ⁠Astus is now linked to Iris: it spots images with no description and writes their alternative text.

change.item: ⁠Astus no longer changes the address of an article, a category or a menu item unless you ask for it; it then sets a 301 redirect from the old address.
⁠It refuses when child pages would change address, and never rewrites the title of published content without your agreement.
⁠The link check now starts from the module button, no longer from the chat.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. A site still on Joomla 6.1 keeps its current version and is offered nothing that could break it.

addition.item: ⁠The visitor assistant has a presentation page: its first tab introduces Astus, with the manual, support and your downloads.

change.item: ⁠The visitor assistant settings move to a tab of their own, “Settings”, right after the presentation.
